name: DFT benchmark for dehydrogenation/dehalogenation on coinage metals
description: A density functional theory benchmark with reference reaction energetics to evaluate DFT approximations for dehydrogenation and dehalogenation on coinage metal surfaces.
reputation: Recognized within the computational surface-science community for benchmarking DFT approximations on coinage metal reactions, but not widely used outside that specialty.
notes: Small, specialized benchmark focused on coinage metals; results sensitive to choice of reference data and computational settings; non-LLM benchmark.
